games.name: Another Card Game
games.summary: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

games.name: Armed Prisoner III
games.summary: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration

games.name: Brick Buddies (Bunnyhop)
games.summary: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

games.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan's Deal
games.summary: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.summary: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

games.name: Defend The HexCore
games.summary: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!

games.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
games.summary: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

games.name: GymPup
games.summary: GymPup is a BL furry romance narrative game that combines idle desktop gameplay with visual novel elements. Accompany the protagonist and witness his transformation—both physical and emotional.

games.name: Haste Makes Waste
games.summary: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.

games.name: Kaidanji
games.summary: 山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのは、正体不明の奇妙な4人の人物だった。聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る怖い話を楽しめます。VHS風画面短編集ホラーノベルゲーム。

games.name: Leviticus
games.summary: Leviticus is a dark sci-fi action game where you play as an angel sent to guard those made in his image. Tasked with defending humanity, you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders, beings that were never made in the image of God. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

games.name: Meow Field
games.summary: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

games.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!
games.summary: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.

games.name: Necrogen
games.summary: Defend a forest watchtower against waves of monsters in a first-person survival shooter. Earn cash from kills, buy weapons and upgrades, fight flying gargoyles, and face bosses in dedicated arenas. Spend your last dollars on ammo or repairs? The next round will test your choice.

games.name: PICK A BOO
games.summary: PICK A BOO is an online co-op action game where you use magnetic powers to stick furniture together and haul it out.

Rubber Stamp Legend
games.summary: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

games.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
games.summary: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

games.name: Veltarum
games.summary: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

games.name: ZJ the Ball
games.summary: Breakthrough Gaming creates Christian themed entertainment products such as video games, animation, comics, and books.

games.name: 100 Views of Japan's Four Seasons
games.summary: Explore the beauty of Japan through relaxing scenic puzzles, spot-the-difference challenges, quizzes, and more across all 47 prefectures.

games.name: A Needle In a Haystack
games.summary: Search a persistent hay pile with 4,000,000 candidates and one winning needle. Work strand by strand alone or with up to three friends, sort the mess, sell strange finds, and unlock better tools in a cozy first-person test of patience.

games.name: a strange journey into the backrooms
games.summary: A strange journey into the backrooms is an atmospheric exploration game focused on an introspective psychological voyage rather than mere survival. Navigate a lethal, endless labyrinth filled with forgotten stories and liminal spaces that stretch beyond the limits of human imagination.

games.name: Abracademia
games.summary: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

games.name: Against Heroes
games.summary: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!

games.name: Amnea28: two eternities
games.summary:
"Amnea 28" is a visual novel about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. Their destination is "Amnea", an old hotel which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago and now serves as the professor's residence. Week of studying didn't promise any problems, yet the atmosphere felt more unsettling with each passing day. 

Why did the students' behavior suddenly become strange? What are they hiding? The protagonist will have to solve all the mysteries of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel won't let her leave alive.

games.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
games.summary: ART NOIRE: Paris is an atmospheric ring-based puzzle game that combines classic film noir aesthetics with the romantic elegance of 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings, align the details, and restore beautiful illustrations.

games.name: Autistic Romance
games.summary: What makes divorce a justified decision? Does it even need to be justified? Each night, choose who to spend your time with. Decide what you believe about relationships at 'The End' of this visual novel.

games.name: Avalon: Legacy Edition
games.summary: Explore the distant world of Avalon, battle dangerous creatures and uncover its secrets in a faithful recreation of the 1998 DOS RPG by its original creators. A classic 2D adventure reborn for modern systems.

games.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic
games.summary: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.

games.name: Between Cats
games.summary: The sky might not be falling but everything else seems to be! Look Out is a high octane mobile experience that will leave players frantically guiding Scaredy Squirrel away from a seemingly non-stop storm of random items falling from the sky. Keep Scaredy upright long enough to climb the ever growing mountain of junk to get to the bottom of all this randomness. Just remember to Look Out!Highlights:•Experience a storm of 36 fun levels•Unlock 9 Scaredy-themed achievements.  •Customizable controls.•Discover helpful power-ups and bonuses•Play in a variety of locations from Scaredy Squirrel’s world

games.name: Billionth Soul
games.summary: Grow humanity’s last colony from one thawed sleeper to one billion souls aboard a failing generation ship. Draft cards, build powerful grid combinations, and trade population against dwindling life support in this idle roguelite deckbuilder. The billionth soul is the hardest one to save.

games.name: Blade Dodger
games.summary: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

games.name: BlockBabe
games.summary: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.

games.name: Boris & the Second Sun
games.summary: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.

games.name: Bouncemetry
games.summary: Bouncemetry is a physics-based incremental game focused on geometric simulations. Unlock different scenarios, such as bouncing mechanics, glass shattering, and color filling, and run them simultaneously. Generate passive income and infinitely scale your simulation parameters through a skill tree.

games.name: BULWARK: Hold the Heart
games.summary: Build an economy, train an army and hold a living swarm back from your colony's Heart. Real-time strategy as wave defence, with the controls RTS players know: control groups, grid hotkeys, shift-queued orders. A 25-level campaign, three heroes, a 121-node War Council tree and an endless mode.

games.name: Cabin Life
games.summary: Create your character, pick your starting gear, and settle into a rented cabin in this immersive, relaxing life simulator. Forage, work odd jobs, sell junk at the thrift store, and keep yourself fed and clean as you save up for the cabin of your dreams.

games.name: Cannon War
games.summary: Cannon War is a pixel-art tower-defense strategy game spanning Ancient, Modern, and Future Warfare. Build towers and barricades to reshape enemy routes, combine weapons and targeting strategies, expand your permanent arsenal, and defend your headquarters through a multi-era campaign.

games.name: Climb Together
games.summary: Play solo or stuck with up to 100 friends, explore various worlds and overcome obstacles together. Unlock abilities and checkpoints that aid your journey to uncover the truth and reach the peak in this challenging 3D co-op platformer!

games.name: Corgi Race Live
games.summary: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.

games.name: Corposlop
games.summary: Coloring Book with all wins club characters.. Have fun with your kids.

games.name: Dear My Son
games.summary: Raise a family, carry on through generations, and fight demons to break a curse passed down through your bloodline in this family legacy simulation game.

games.name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
Desktop Goofy Guys
games.summary: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

games.name: Emberbound: Three Pyres
games.summary: Draw fire with every step. Close blazing loops to burn through the horde, combine ten powers, and survive fifteen minutes before facing a guardian. Free three haunted realms as a tiny ember that refuses to fade.

games.name: Evenicle - Next Fragment Medica
games.summary: In a world where human civilization is threatened by monsters, only the rare few individuals who wield forbidden skills dare challenge them. However, these brave warriors have to face an even more dangerous hazard... The Hero Syndrome. Only a young doctor can hope to cure the disease in this JRPG!

games.name: Eye of Darkness
games.summary:
Eye of Darkness is a survivor rogue-lite game with a focus on exploration in which you take on the role of a cultist trying to summon the Eye of Darkness.

The forces of Light and Darkness have been locked in an eternal struggle for ultimate power. For eons, the Light has suppressed the Darkness, imprisoning the Eye of Darkness to maintain its dominance. Under the Light’s rule, humanity lives under strict laws and rigid hierarchies, to suppress heresy.

But now, a cult devoted to the Darkness sees an opportunity...

games.name: Farmstead Market Simulator
games.summary: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.

games.name: For The King II: Dust to Dust Character Pack
Forbidden House
games.summary: Forbidden House is a first-person puzzle adventure with over 40 puzzles to solve.

games.name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG Demo
Game Launch Simulator
games.summary: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.

games.name: Go Next!
games.summary: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

games.name: Golden Pan
games.summary: A cozy gold panning game. Wash the creek gravel, watch the gold settle in your pan, sell your finds in the village, and turn a small empty room into a home. No timers, no failure. Just quiet, golden little days.

games.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator
games.summary: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.

games.name: Gotching
games.summary: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

games.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Hotdog Killer
games.summary: Fun Foxy Top Gear Challenge - Free Street Surfing Endurance Race is an exciting fast pasted game. Remember Street Surfing in the Michael J. Fox movie Teen Wolf? Control Fun Foxy the Fox as he Street Surfs on a variety of crazy cars like the Delorean from Back to the Future, The Flintstones car, and the Ghostbusters Ambulance. Turbocharge Foxy in a rallycross style race to the north.

games.name: Hozy
games.summary:
After things don’t quite work out in the big city, you return to your small hometown. Once lively, it now feels a little faded and forgotten. In that stillness, you discover something unexpected: a new passion. Room by room, space by space, you clean, paint, and gently restore the sense of community that once filled these streets.

Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you're wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Open a window to let the wind play with floating dust and bring nature's sounds closer. Light candles, arrange books on shelves, paint a portrait on the wall, or switch on a projector. Everything you touch and every choice you make delivers a sense of satisfaction and a gentle “aha!” moment.

games.name: Hunter Bro VR
games.summary: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 friends.

games.name: Idle Camp Tale
games.summary: Camp & Conquer is a fantasy idle RPG. Manage your camp, recruit heroes, and let auto-battles fight for you. Farm gear and materials from every fight, then strengthen, enchant, and customize affixes to forge your own powerful equipment as you conquer the frontier stage by stage!

games.name: Kebab Dynasty
games.summary: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

games.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.

games.name: Kreabordis
games.summary: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.

games.name: Law Firm Simulator
games.summary: Law Firm Simulator is a business management sandbox where you build and run your own legal empire. Hire lawyers, take on clients, manage complex cases, expand your offices, and grow a small practice into the city’s most prestigious law firm.

games.name: Little Lands
games.summary: Build your world, one hex at a time. Little Lands is a peaceful, low-stress world builder where you gather resources, expand your landscape, and create a world of your own. No timers, no game overs, just build, decorate, and enjoy.

games.name: Lost Crystal Adventure
games.summary: When mysterious changes begin to affect the kingdom, the king summons a young adventurer to Xenopolis and entrusts them with a quest that could decide the realm’s fate. Journey through dangerous lands and uncover the secrets surrounding the crystal. What awaits you on the road ahead?

games.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows
games.summary: An autobattler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team. Upgrade your units and defeat increasingly stronger enemies in this rogue-like game.

games.name: March and Conquer
games.summary: Kawaii Find is a super cute fast-paced object search game. You have just 60 seconds to find as many objects as you can to obtain a high score!Once the kawaii images are randomly placed on the board, you must find all of the specified item on each page as they refresh until your 60 seconds are up! Features:- Game Center Leaderboards Integration- Super kawaii hand drawn images- Fast-paced addictive play style!**Be sure to "like" Last Haven Games on Facebook for news and details on future updates! http://www.facebook.com/lasthavengames

games.name: Masyu: Line Logic
games.summary: A relaxing logic puzzle where you draw one loop through every circle, going straight through the white ones and turning on the black ones. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 15,000 more, Easy to Expert.

games.name: Mazehold
games.summary: Build the maze. Hold the keep. A tower defense roguelite without waves: survive one relentless 20-minute siege, turn every tower into part of your maze, discover 21 tower combos, draft cards as you level up and face four demon bosses.

games.name: Megachest
games.summary: Megachest is an incremental game about opening chests, discovering legendary loot, and building your ultimate fortune empire! Start with simple rewards and grow into a master of magic and riches as you unlock rare items, upgrade your power, and hire helpers to automate your chest-opening journey

games.name: Menthal
games.summary: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

games.name: Metro Resonance
games.summary: An intense 30-minute first-person survival thriller set in a post-apocalyptic underground. Survive a pitch-black tunnel, gather spare parts to fix your handcar, and reach the sealing station before your gas mask filter runs out.

games.name: Mini Battleships
games.summary: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. A calm, minimalist naval roguelike with an ever-changing soundtrack, where the sea always wins in the end, but never before you look magnificent.

games.name: Mini Mart Survivors
games.summary: SHIFT24 is no ordinary convenience store chain. Strange customers swarm in endlessly, and ramen, snacks, coffee, anything on the shelf is a weapon. Fend them off, chase the clues worldwide, and pay your debt to uncover SHIFT24's truth.

games.name: Neon One-Man Army
games.summary: High-speed, neon-infused single-player action! Swing through platforms with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne to survive. Choose powerful cards at every level, unlock skill chests, and master the ultimate momentum-based power fantasy.

games.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
games.summary: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

games.name: Palisade
games.summary: Draw borders, build roads and strongholds, and conquer rival realms in a fast single-player strategy game fought across sixteen historically grounded scenarios. Command five campaigns, custom Skirmishes, and a shared Daily Chronicle.

games.name: Path to Catakombs
games.summary: Build and defend an armored train through ever-changing underground routes. Recruit gunners, alchemists, and mechanics, upgrade your wagons, choose your path, and survive relentless kobold raids and colossal bosses.

games.name: PeeVPee
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

games.name: Picronix 2
games.summary:
Take a breather and challenge your brain with these calming logic puzzles

Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Solve the number clues to reveal hidden pixel art pictures. Solving each row and column brings you closer to the final image. Enjoy the perfect blend of calm and challenge. A lot unique puzzles await you. They're perfect for a quick break or a long session. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

games.name: Plum
games.summary: Plum is a 3d cozy platforming and collectathon game where you will have to roll and bounce through the valley in search for home. On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share. This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.

games.name: Progress98
games.summary: A retro incremental idle desktop companion all about making progress on the side and at your own pace.

games.name: REC:REWIND
games.summary: Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him. Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

games.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas
games.summary: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. Are you willing to help Santa this year?

games.name: Score Circuit
games.summary: Chain risky scoring nodes, cash out before the circuit burns out, and unlock 30 modifiers that bend every run. Score Circuit is a compact neon score-attack roguelite about one more carefully calculated push.

games.name: Scrapline (Tenth Studio)
games.summary: Scrapline is a third-person wave-survival roguelite shooter. Rogue robots fill a live-fire range, and you have one gun. Pick a weapon aspect: Bounce, Turrets, Burn or Blast. Spend salvage, pick one of 20 characters with real trade-offs, survive 20 waves, then chase your Endless record.

games.name: Shademarch
games.summary: An async PvP autobattler. Build four heroes from 21 classes, draft the skills and items that change how they fight, then watch them battle other players' teams. Progress through the March, or climb the ranks on an even playing field in the Arena.

games.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder
games.summary: Build the robot. Design the tactics with Thought Tiles. Then just watch. Assemble the 18cm-tall autonomous hobby robot “SIGNOS” and program its behavior logic with flowchart-style “Thought Tiles.” No controls during battle — SIGNOS fights on its own, guided solely by the logic you designed.

games.name: Sword of the Last Second
games.summary: You have been bestowed the 'Sword of the Demiurge' and the authority to sever the bonds of soul and flesh. Make haste for your appointed time has arrived. Defeat your foes, collect their souls, and manifest your authority, until the myriads fall before you in a single moment.

games.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer
games.summary: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.

games.name: Terrified Gorillas
games.summary: A co-op VR horror game. You're a gorilla trapped in Primal Dynamics' abandoned test facilities, and the monsters know you're here. Climb, run and hide through mazes, sewers and the backrooms with your friends, or become the monster in Monster Hunt.

games.name: The Big Suck
games.summary: A short incremental game where you are the disaster. Destroy fields, cars, buildings. Gather wreck to grow and spend it on upgrades inside the big skill tree.

games.name: The Great Sassanelli - An Interactive Novel
The Guiding Light - Five-Class Cosmetic Pack
The Horror (Strange Crow)
games.summary: Of all man's mistakes none compares to The Horror. Tremble in its presence, panic, struggle, scream. Nothing will prepare you for the horror of The Horror. A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.

games.name: The Inspector
games.summary: a Train has been infected with mysterious anomalies. G.O.A.B has secretly hired you to inspect the train. It's your job to find the anomalies and terminate them.

games.name: The Staring Man
games.summary: A first-person horror game set in a Japanese convenience store. You work the night shift alone. Across the street, a man stands staring at you every night. As you encounter inexplicable events, you investigate the mystery of a former employee who disappeared.

games.name: Tidy Up Mall
games.summary: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 4,990 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

games.name: Tiny Village (Elpoco)
games.summary: Tiny Village is an incremental game where you gather resources and use them to develop your village. Collect resources, unlock upgrades, and gradually grow your small village!

games.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
Towers of Babble
games.summary: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together, we must beat them all and talk our way back into heaven.

games.name: Tube2K
games.summary: Build the video sharing platform that will change the world. Will you bring about the Golden Age of humanity or bring it to its knees?

games.name: Twin-stick Japanese
games.summary: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

games.name: UFO98
games.summary: Defy the government, leak top-secret alien telemetry, and wake up the world… inside an isolated Win98 workstation.

games.name: Vestalborne
games.summary: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is a co-op action-RPG sandbox of fast combat, deep dungeons, and endless crafting across many dimensions. Keep the Eternal Flame burning in a solo adventure, with friends, or against them.

games.name: Vida:Unslain
games.summary: Vida: Unslain is a dungeon exploration game where players explore labyrinths, battle enemies, choose their path, and progress through each dungeon.

games.name: Vinculum
games.summary: Do the math and survive the aftermath. An easy-to-learn card battler: pull off math combos, get stuck in a fraction, stack functions until the numbers go absurd, break the enemy lines, try not to divide by zero. Real, modern, correct math. But when math isn't enough, resort to more arcane means...

games.name: Waifu Curator
games.summary: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying collectible scale figures. Collect, organize, and build the perfect exhibition!

games.name: What the Buck?!
games.summary: What the Buck?! is an incremental game about destroying money. Smash stacks of cash, upgrade your destructive power, automate your money withdrawals, declare bankruptcy and watch the numbers explode.

games.name: Wild Hive
games.summary: Wild Hive is a bee colony sim driven by a ruthless honey market. Hatch workers, brew honey, and sell it well — because the quota climbs every year, and the year you miss it, your run is over. Build Your HiveLay brood cells for your queen, raise honey silos, and shape the hex grid your colony lives in. Every silo type pushes the hive's temperature, humidity, and CO₂ — your floor plan is your climate control. Build it right and brew four varieties of honey; build it wrong and cook your own bees. Forage or StarveSend workers on nectar runs, from the safety of Bluebell Woods to the rich, risky Alpine Meadows — every trip a bet on yield against the odds of coming home. Fields deplete as you strip them and refill with the seasons, so rotate your crews or fly home empty. Upgrade a favorite field for bigger stockpiles, faster flights, or a shot at Super Nectar. Play the MarketHoney has one price, and it never sits still. Ride the booms, dodge the crashes, and sell at the peak to clear the year's quota before winter runs out. Work the RAX exchange on the side — buy shares in five rival hives, pocket the dividends, and lease out idle bees for a steady cut. Survive the SeasonsYour hive breathes: temperature, humidity, and CO₂ drift with the weather and your own architecture. Let one cross the red line and bees die, honey spoils, silos crumble. When winter freezes your nectar solid, thaw it fast — or lose it. Defend the QueenWasps raid the hive. Workers drop everything and charge; you hire mercenary bees to hold the line. When the last defender falls, the wasps go for the Queen — and if she dies, so does the colony.  Hatch, feed, and put to work a swarm of autonomous bees — every one of them mortal. Grow honey silos through 9 levels and 4 types to brew 4 varieties of honey. Pin up to 3 Royal Seals a year — permanent modifiers that bend the rules of your run. Trade shares in 5 rival hives and lease out your workforce on the RAX exchange. Settle 5 biomes, from fishing the Mountain Lake to catching apples in the Juicy Orchards. Outplay a rival queen at Honeycomb Clash, or ferment your surplus into mead at the Meadery. Reach level 30, then climb 7 tiers of Wax difficulty that rewrite the rules against you. Or ignore the quota entirely in Endless mode and grow the biggest hive you can.Your first colony will collapse. Your empire starts with the next one.

games.summary: Hard West 2 is a journey to the heart of darkness in the American West. Take control of a supernatural posse and catch the mysterious Ghost Train. Outsmart, outcheat and outgun your enemies in this turn-based tactics game set in a Wild West world where nothing is as it seems.

games.name: Hexograph
games.summary: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

games.name: Hidden Bananas
games.summary: Find hidden bananas across tropical islands! Relaxing point-and-click gameplay with beautiful ocean views and soothing music. Can you spot them all?

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary:
Only the foolish and the desperate attempt to wander the mazelike trails of Hillthorn. Even those who know their way may still stumble upon dangerous wildlife or a local villager’s piercing gaze. 

But a child has gone missing, time is in short supply, and you’re the one being tasked with unraveling the mountain’s secrets. 

Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game unlike any other, where the mystery unfolds without a single word spoken.

games.name: Homemaking: Build & Decorate
games.summary: Build a home from the first wall to the last cushion. Draw rooms on a one-metre grid, cut in doors and windows, paper the walls, then furnish them from 1,284 pieces. No timers, no budget, no wrong answers - just you, a house, and the light moving across the floor.

Each decade features its own visual identity and carefully curated tracklist, letting you jump between musical eras or build the ultimate throwback-to-modern playlist in one seamless experience. Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge.

Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt.

games.name: Never Sort By Color

Fill drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

Stardew Valley meets Pokemon! Experience a wholesome farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

You can grow everything from normal crops, berry bushes, and fruit trees, to heart fruit, weird herbs, and mushrooms from other dimensions! From your harvest you can cook high-quality food for your blobs to help them grow healthy and strong.

In the world of Ova Magica, people live side by side with these cute creatures, and you can raise them to be strong, loyal friends and sidekicks! To make your blobs stronger, you must feed them well, pet them and use specific skills in battles.

games.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense

games.name: RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition
games.summary:
RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos.

RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride.

SYNERGIZING COINS & CHAOS
Discover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a Multiply Coin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Launch a Nuclear Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once!

CRAFT POWERFUL STRATEGIES WITH ITEMS
Stack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry. Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos.

DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, DISTINCT PLAYSTYLES
Play as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends.

Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: The Fixer

games.name: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
games.summary:
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature is a peaceful and reflective experience, filled with meaningful collectibles, unique emotion-driven interactions, and environmental puzzles. The orchestral soundtrack emphasizes an intimate storyline of unlikely friendship, loss, and love.

Travel across vast, beautifully diverse landscapes, each seamlessly blending into the next, filled with unique flora and fauna waiting to be discovered. The progress you make is reflected in the vibrant flowers blooming on the Golem’s back. There are many secrets and collectibles to discover, making for a rewarding exploration experience.

Solve puzzles that shape the environment around you. Use the Golem’s abilities to interact with the world in creative ways, unlocking new paths and uncovering secrets. Hidden within the remnants of a lost civilization lies the means to reclaim and rejuvenate Nature.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

games.name: Would you mine?
games.summary: A Minesweeper incremental game where you mine resources, upgrade your pickaxe and stats, and avoid being killed by enemies on your way to revealing ancient relics.

games.name: A Snail's Tale
games.summary:
It's called A Snail's Tale - that might lead you to believe that the snail is the main character, but nay, friend. The player takes control of Samson Spligglebarp, the noble descendant of a famed historian who is eager to make his own mark on the world.

Samson travels to the Halite Kingdom to enter King Phillippe's challenge, competing against other adventurers for a chance to be a Halite Warrior. The King reveals that he is eternally pursued by an immortal snail who will never rest until he is destroyed.

And so begins the quest of Samson and his intrepid companions, the Halite Warriors, to gather the three Crystals of Power and stop the snail before he catches the King.

Castlebound
games.summary:
Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

Castlebound is a thrilling roguelike action game where you and your allies must defend a walking castle while battling relentless waves of monstrous foes.

Join Lenora, a skilled archer, and her wise grandfather Vargus as they awaken an ancient structure that transforms into a living fortress.

Guided by the enigmatic Coronya, they must gather powerful warriors to fight the malevolent forces threatening the realm.

Fakin' It XL
games.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary:
17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

Hope in the City is a narrative mystery game, set in the Chinese city of Shenyang, by the team behind the 2026 GDC Best in Play Winner Sky of Tides and the Annie Award-nominated Eternal Spring. Play as Hope, a 17-year-old girl investigating her parents' disappearance, connecting the clues and uncovering the truth hidden beneath the city's calm.

NO NOTE NO WARNING
You come home from school like any other day. But the house is too quiet. Your parents are gone, the apartment is in shambles. No note, no warning, no answer. Hope Song is 17, and she's just become the only person willing to ask what really happened.

AN ARTIST’S EYE
Hope isn't a detective. She's an artist. And that's exactly what makes her dangerous to whoever's hiding the truth. Every room holds details that don't add up: a shadow in the wrong place, an object that shouldn't be there, a lie in someone's eyes.

Capture what you see as sketches in Hope's notebook. Every detail matters.

FROM OBSERVATION TO TRUTH
Connect what you've seen into insights, and push those insights until they crack open into breakthroughs. Piece by piece, sketch by sketch, the picture of what happened to your parents starts to take shape, and it's darker than you imagined.

A CITY FULL OF SECRETS
Shenyang isn't just a backdrop, it's a character of its own. Rendered in a bold, stylized art style with an edge, every street, storefront, and shadowed alley is begging to be explored. Wander past neon signs and quiet corners alike, and let the city's striking visuals pull you deeper into its secrets.

WHO CAN YOU TRUST?
On the surface, it's just home: familiar streets, quiet neighbors, ordinary life. But beneath Hope's peaceful existence, secrets are buried. And now it's her time to find the truth.

A PET SHOP AFTER DARK is a horror point-and-click visual novel where you've taken on an odd job at a little pet shop. The owner tells you the job is easy - all you have to do is water the plants, feed the pets, and stay the night. 

There's just one thing - do NOT, under any circumstances, turn off the lights.

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.summary:
Adorable Adventures is a relaxing third-person exploration game where you play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn to use his nose to reunite with his family, who were separated after a forest fire.

Across rolling meadows, sun-dappled forest paths, deep caves, and rocky highlands, identify scents and follow trails to learn more about the world around you. Search for your brothers and sisters, uncover secrets, and expand your library of smells against the backdrop of a gentle and heart-warming story.

games.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Boxing - MotionPlay
games.summary:
Step into the ring and become the boxer and keep fit.

Using the free MotionPlay App on a compatible smartphone, your phone’s camera tracks your movements and turns them into action in the game. Raise your guard, throw jabs and hooks, and block incoming attacks as you battle it out in the ring.

Take on 7 different fighters, each with their own strengths and fighting style. Every match is fought across 3 intense rounds - land the knockout blow before your opponent knocks you out!
Boxing MotionPlay creates an immersive experience where your movements control the action, making you feel physically part of the game rather than simply controlling a character. Punch, block and react as the fight unfolds around you.

It’s also a fun way to get active. Boxing MotionPlay can turn a gaming session into an energetic, fitness-style workout while you play.

Powered by patent-pending MotionPlay body-tracking technology, setup is quick and simple, with no additional camera accessory or wearable controller required.

games.name: Bumperhead
games.summary:
Bumperhead is a 3D ragdoll physics crash comedy. You are the newest test subject for the Ministry of Questionable Safety, and your job is simple: climb into a ridiculous vehicle, speed down tracks full of ramps and hazards, and crash as spectacularly as possible.

Your rider is a floppy ragdoll with real physics. Every bump throws them from the seat, sends them tumbling and bending in all the wrong directions, while the vehicle falls apart piece by piece around them. It is all slapstick, with no blood, just bruises, bandages and very bad decisions.

games.name: Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys
games.summary:
Cats have gotten angry about so many memes… now they’ve rebelled against the internet.

The memes were funny… until the cats fought back.

In Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Boys, a rebellion begins.
Not against people… but against the digital world that turned them into icons.

Step into a chaotic clash where charm turns dangerous, and nothing online is safe anymore.

games.name: Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Girls
games.summary:
Cats ruled the internet… now they’re taking it back.

The memes were funny… until the cats fought back.

In Cats vs Internet: Rise of the Memes Girls, a rebellion begins.
Not against people… but against the digital world that made them a joke.

Step into a chaotic clash where cute turns dangerous, and nothing online is safe anymore.

♠ BATTLE THE INTERNET WITH CARDS
Face the internet itself in strategic card battles.
Build your deck, unleash powerful combos, and prove that cats rule the web.

♣ DATE CATGIRLS AND POWER UP
Behind every card, there’s a girl.
Win their trust, go on dates, and unlock new abilities that transform your strategy.

♥ FROM CUTE TO CHAOS
What starts as adorable quickly turns unpredictable.
The deeper you go, the weirder it gets.
This is not just a game… it’s a war.

♦ BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE DECK
Collect, upgrade, and combine cards to create unstoppable strategies.
Every decision matters—both in battle and in love.

games.name: Combat Kart
games.summary: A casual yet thrilling kart racing game. Experience top-notch drifting, exhilarating nitro boosts, adorable characters, and unique combat skills. Supports local multiplayer for up to four players and Remote Play Together!Get the ultimate experience on the Steam Deck as well.

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.summary:
Oh, no! Morris lost his engagement ring and is too broke to buy another! Luckily, beautiful rings can be won on the top floor of the arcade.

Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.

Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines... and claw back Morris’ relationship!

games.name: Emoji Killer - Space Rampage
games.summary:
Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!

You awake in a mysterious casino where evil poker emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.

This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a wild casino environments, fast-paced combat against gambling addicted emojis wearing funny hats and wielding powers.

Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash maximum casino power for maximum challenge.

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?

Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.

Can you conquer the casino before the emojis claim you?

games.name: Fluffy Friends - Counting Farm
games.summary:
15 preschool mini games with adorable farm animals!

Fluffy Friends is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a breathtaking forest full of rivers, colourful trees and adorable zoo animals, this is early education at its most enchanting.
Children count exotic animals, compare groups, train their memory, find the biggest and smallest creatures, and tap numbers in the correct order — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated.
Whether played together or explored independently, Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool makes every learning moment feel like a magical adventure in the forest.

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE
Did you see this animal? Which animal did you not see? Which group has the most animals? Count all animals and species Find the biggest and smallest animal Remember the order and tap correctly Memory and much more!

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer, where you must fight your way through shifting corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in the legendary absurdity and classic animation inspired by the era of Earthworm Jim.

games.name: Harold Halibut
games.summary:
Harold Halibut is a handmade narrative game about friendship, and life on a city-sized spaceship submerged in an alien ocean. 

It's been 250 years since your home - an ark-like spaceship - fled an Earth on the verge of cold war to find a habitable planet on which to preserve the human race. 
You are Harold, a young lab assistant for the ship's lead scientist, Jeanne Mareaux. While most of the ship's inhabitants have reconciled themselves to a life lived aboard the sunken ship, Mareaux still works tirelessly to find a way for the ship to leave the planet and find a new, dryer home. 

But of course the weird, wonderful and diverse people of the Fedora keep Harold busy too. Until one fateful encounter plunges Harold into a new world that nobody could have guessed existed - and one that may hold the key to Mareaux's re-launch plans. 

Join Harold as he explores a vibrant retro-future world, talks (with full voice acting) to its inhabitants, and occasionally goes hands on by sticking screwdrivers in things, operating complex machinery, and more in his quest to find the true meaning of 'home'.

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary:
The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

games.name: Kaiju Boys: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
games.summary:
Fight him. Trap him. Date him. Hold on... you're going out with the thing that ate the harbor?!

Giant monsters are tearing the city apart, and you're the only one crazy enough to try catching them.

Plot twist: every kaiju you trap turns into a ridiculously hot anime boy who still has a habit of knocking over buildings.

Beat them in turn-based battles, trap them before they flatten another block, and watch the transformation happen. Then ask them out and hope he doesn't breathe fire on the waiter.

A few of the monsters waiting for you:

● A lava-blooded lizard turned hothead hunk who gets jealous enough to melt the pavement.

● A giant moth guy who can't resist a bright light, or a cute smile.

● A deep-sea titan with a cold stare, broad shoulders, and a soft spot he swears he doesn't have.

games.name: Kaiju Girls: Trap Giant Monsters & Fall in Love
games.summary:
Beat the kaiju. Trap the kaiju. Date the kaiju. Wait... the giant lizard is your girlfriend now?!

Giant monsters are flattening the city, and you're the only one with a trap big enough to stop them. The twist? Every kaiju you catch turns into a gorgeous anime girl who still remembers stomping on skyscrapers.

Fight them in turn-based battles, trap them before they wreck another block, and watch them transform. Then take them on dates and try not to get stepped on.

Meet a few of your catches:

♡ A fire-breathing reptile turned hot-headed beauty who melts down if you show up late.

♡ A giant moth girl drawn to every bright light in the city, including you.

♡ A deep-sea titan with an icy stare and a surprisingly soft side.

Other guys save the city. You get to date the things trying to destroy it. Ready?

games.name: Marble Saga - The Curse of the Sun Temple
games.summary:
A terrible drought plagues the Valley of Amara, and legend has it that only the scattered fire of the ancient Temple of the Sun can put an end to it. As the daughter of the temple’s guardian, Amara descends into its cursed depths to gather the fragmented sun—chamber by chamber—convinced that she is the heroine foretold by an ancient prophecy.

*Marble Saga: The Curse of the Temple of the Sun* is a narrative-driven take on the classic marble-shooting game. A chain of colored marbles winds along a twisting path toward the fiery heart of the temple. From an ancient, sundial-shaped launcher at the center of the chamber, aim and fire your own marbles; match three or more of the same color to break the chain and set it back. Power-ups add excitement to every session: explosive blasts, precision darts, a rainbow marble that connects with any color, a time-freeze ability, and a last-second reversal that pushes the chain back before it reaches the end. Complete the course to win, save your score, and uncover the rest of the story.

This is a complete, standalone adventure within the *Marble Saga* series, chronicling Amara’s journey across 150 hand-crafted levels. Each level features a unique environment with its own winding layout, a distinct aesthetic, and brand-new surprises. As you progress, the narrative deepens: what begins as a simple quest to rekindle the sun evolves into a tale that reveals the true heroes—and villains—behind the legend.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds behind Persona 3, 4, and 5 comes Metaphor: ReFantazio, a unique fantasy world, where your protagonist will journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart. By awakening to an “Archetype,” you will unlock the power to channel and combine the abilities of unique job classes. Strengthen your bonds and build your party to take down powerful foes and discover the kingdom’s true nature.

-Go on uests, dungeon dive, & hunt for treasures by day. Strengthen relationships, build bonds, & increase virtues by night. Choose your actions wisely, time management is key to achieving your goal. 

Ride your “gauntlet runner” to faraway dungeons & towns across an expansive world. Discover beautiful landscapes  accompanied by captivating music, immersive UI, & anime cutscenes.

A unique battle system combining turn based & real time action grants strategy & exhilaration at every turn. Party customization through “Archetypes” provides freedom to personalize your adventure. 

A mysterious & exciting story unfolds in a world where people must fight their own anxiety. Join the high-stakes Royal Tournament that promises hours of captivating exploration and discovery.

games.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
games.summary:
Moomin: Midsummer Madness is a delightfully playful point-and-click adventure inspired by Tove Jansson’s cherished Nordic fantasy novel, Moominsummer Madness. 

Play as Moomintroll and Little My as they explore a curious old theatre caught in a great flood. The journey will be filled with endearing encounters, familiar faces, and a touch of mischief.

games.name: Mr.Bump
games.summary: EGGCONSOLE Mr.Bump PC-8801mkIISR

games.name: MyRummy 2
games.summary:
The legendary tile-laying classic – combine cleverly, make smart moves, and add a little luck to be the first to play all your tiles.

Lay, combine, win!

Create runs and groups, match colors and numbers, and use your jokers at just the right moment.
Play with family and friends or take on the AI in solo matches. The first player to get rid of all their tiles wins!

• Easy to learn: Simple rules and instant fun
• Think ahead: Strategy, clever moves, and a little bit of luck
• Atmospheric settings: Choose your favorite place to play
• Play with family and friends – or challenge the AI
• Up to 4 players can compete against each other

games.name: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 1
games.summary:
After rescuing the Cherubim, Mint, who you find passed out by the side of the road following her exile from Heaven, she moves in with you. Your close friendship naturally blossoms into something more, and she becomes your girlfriend. There's never a dull moment with the cheerful, naively honest, and rambunctious Mint by your side, which is only amplified when Lily, a half-demon and close friend of Mint's, suddenly shows up on your doorstep in all her over-the-top flirtatious glory.

Mint, the Cherubim, is eager to repay you for saving her life after she'd passed out from hunger. Unfortunately, she's pretty clumsy, and no matter what she cooks, it always comes out a charcoal brick. Welcome to your new, honeymoon-esque lovey-dovey life alongside the cat-eared Cherubim, Mint!

Follow Mint, a popular girl from the doujin circle "Animal Herb," as she stars in this brand new, heart-warmingly comedic game!

games.name: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 2
games.summary: Mint and her friends return in NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES 2! In order to save her family, a girl will defy fate itself and become the personification of miracles...

games.name: Panda: Shards of Aurora
games.summary: This new puzzle game mixes math with explosions. Not real explosions, just colored confetti. It's very addictive, you might lose track of time and keep playing all day.Swipe two or more numbers that add to the needed sum, then the numbers explode. If you get stuck you can buy a hint or more time with your coins.School your brain and get smart drilling with this online game--kids, adults, boys and girls will have fun. Compete against your friends for most coins or highest level.CUSTOM PLAY  Lets you create a variety of games, cool puzzles or action play. Options for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, speed, board size, difficulty, colors and more.DAILY SPIN  Spin the reels once a day and win up to 10,000 free coins.OTHER APPS  Check out Falling Numbers, another cool math game from Mountain Science.Be sure to rate this game and tell us what you like! Your feedback helps us make games better."I can't stop playing on the Speed Preset, I get all amped up and I want to get to the next level, it's really intense when the timer is about to run out and I don't have all the solutions yet!" -- Dave (the developer)

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary:
Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition!

Meet Pikmin: small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with creatures multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. 

Dandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and sometimes explorers like to get in on some friendly competition.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game features Dandori Academy, an extensive series of Dandori exam stages for you to test your skill and earn in-game medals! A total of 72 stages will be released over time - and they vary in difficulty, so you can choose the ones that match your skill level.

games.name: Ski Jumping World Cup
games.summary:
Ski Jumping World Cup takes players to the world’s most iconic ski jumping hills, offering competition in both single player modes and online matches against opponents from around the globe. Feel the adrenaline of ski jumping as you compete on 18 varied hills, take part in World Cup, or create your own tournament tailored to your preferences.


Push yourself in competitive tournaments, sharpen your technique in practice mode, or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online duels.

Precision. Nerves. Flight.

games.name: Solitaire Companions - Dogs
games.summary: Solitaire Companions - Dogs is a Puzzle game, developed and published by TB Games.

games.name: Solitaire Dreams - Modern Princesses
games.summary: Solitaire Dreams - Modern Princesses, the game.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

games.name: SuperMarket Mess!
games.summary:
A cozy store organizing simulator for anyone seeking calm. Over 10,000 items await their place - collect plushies for tidy shelves as each store sparkles again.

Bring a messy Corner Shop and a big Supermarket back to order, one item at a time. Find where everything belongs, earn a plush for every full shelf and grow your skill tree. Easy to start, hard to put down.

Products are scattered across the floor, piled up in the aisles and hiding in quiet corners. It’s up to you to find them a home: fruit and veggies settle into baskets, frozen pizza goes back into the freezer, and every item finds its spot.

Begin in the Corner Shop, where 2,260 items fill 8 departments and 8 cute plushies wait to be found. The supermarket ups it to 8,023 products across 15 sections and 15 more plush friends. That’s 10,283 things to put right, and the quiet joy of seeing every shelf fall into place.

With charming characters, playful products and a warm, peaceful atmosphere, even the biggest mess feels like an invitation to unwind.

SKILL UPGRADES:
Give your inner neat freak a few superpowers. Pull in matching products with Magnetic Hands, highlight items by category and scan shelves to see what belongs where. Gain experience and unlock upgrades to carry more, reach further and move faster.

games.name: Supermarket Simulator
games.summary:
Run your own supermarket. Stock shelves, handle cashier tasks, process online orders, design & expand. Set the prices based on the market. 

In "Supermarket Simulator", every decision matters. Will you rise to the occasion, transforming a modest establishment into a retail powerhouse, all while balancing customer satisfaction, finances, and mafia expectations?

games.name: The Thaumaturge
games.summary:
The Thaumaturge is an isometric, story-rich RPG with a unique take on turn-based combat, character development features, and investigation mechanics, facing you with morally ambiguous choices set in a world teeming with mysterious powers and strange ethereal beings called Salutors.

The year is 1905. Warsaw lives under the yoke of imperial Russian tsardom. Its inhabitants constitute a diverse group of different ancestries, views, and beliefs with often conflicting interests: Russian soldiers, Jewish merchants, Polish townspeople, and more. Despite the circumstances, the city is a buzzing metropolis, where one can attend a breathtaking party with the high society, and later get robbed in one of the dark alleys of the Praga district. A city of great hopes and dreams on one hand and dark desires on the other.

In this world, a force that cannot be ignored are Thaumaturges individuals versed in taming spirit-like beings called Salutors, used for manipulation of the temperaments and affinities of other people and even ultimately in combat. The devil is in the detail - only Thaumaturges are fully aware of the Salutors' nature and only they can perceive them in their true essence. Their capability to influence others significantly and demonstrably increases their ability to change the surrounding world - however, Thaumaturgy is a power that should be used with caution.

games.name: Tropical Eye Spot the Difference
games.summary:
How carefully can you observe a picture-perfect holiday scene?

Blue seas, sandy beaches and poolside sunshine set the scene for a relaxed spot-the-difference game featuring glamorous women enjoying a tropical resort.

The rules are simple. Compare two illustrations placed side by side and select the place on the right-hand image that looks different.

• Study both illustrations closely
• Compare the people, belongings and background details
• Find all the differences across 40 puzzles

Some differences may look obvious at first, yet prove surprisingly tricky to find. Take your time and examine every part of the scene, from the characters and their belongings to the smallest background details.

With no complicated rules to learn, it is ideal for a quick break or a few spare minutes. Play alone at your own pace, or search together with family and friends.

Can you discover every difference in all 40 puzzles?

games.name: UKKARIANS
games.summary:
Was that “oops” really an accident?

Team up and take on a variety of minigames!
But watch out—there are traitors among your teammates, secretly trying to make the team fail.
The SHIKKARIANS are the cooperative team. Work together to reach the target score!
The UKKARIANS are the traitor team. Pretend to help while secretly getting in the way!
Reach the target score, and the SHIKKARIANS win!
Miss the target, and it’s time to vote on who the traitors are!
Unmask every traitor, and the SHIKKARIANS pull off a comeback victory. If even one goes undetected, the UKKARIANS win!
“Didn’t that move look a little suspicious?”
“No, I just messed up! Honest!”
Watch what everyone does during the minigames to uncover the traitors!
Great plays and suspicious slip-ups get everyone laughing and guessing.
Enjoy thrilling minigame showdowns that’ll have everyone saying “One more round!” every time you play!
〈UKKARIANS Features〉
◆ 12 minigames packed with “oops” moments!
- Block Tower:
Take turns dropping blocks and stacking them without toppling the tower! Could there be a reason behind that risky placement?
- Team Jump Rope:
One player swings the rope while the others jump! You’re trying to get in sync, but somehow the timing just isn’t right…
- Frantic Track Relay:

games.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Weed Supermarket Simulator is a chill store sim where you grow weed, develop new strains, set prices, and keep your shelves stocked. Expand your business and optimize it for maximum profit. Manage employees, handle inventory, and turn your shop into a high-performing business.

games.name: DERELIKT
games.summary:
Inspired by the mood and structure of System Shock 2, Alien Resurrection, Doom 3, and, DERELIKT leans into the dread of being under-equipped, out of your depth, and very far from help.

Von Neumann Outpost is a remote research station built into a derelict asteroid in Saturn’s orbit. Now its halls are dark, its systems are failing, and the few survivors left inside aren't telling the same story.

Explore the outpost’s secrets, its corridors, labs, maintenance shafts, and crew quarters. And venture deeper into stranger places inside the rock. Search for supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and unlock new routes through a station that grows more dangerous the deeper you go.

games.name: DONGDA Gangster
games.summary:
About This Game
Immersed in the turbulent "Tohoku" underworld epicof the 1980s, "Northeast Past" is a real-life interactivevideo game that combines hardcore underworldsurvival rules with multi-branching narratives, takingyou to experience the underworld and get involved inthe bloody fate of gang disputes.

A Star-Studded Team for an Authentic Adaptation
Directed by Kong Ergou, the original author of the novel, the game stays true to the core of the beloved storyline. Di Huangjin, a renowned interactive movie game producer, oversees the entire gameplay experience from concept to release. The original star cast of the IP also returns for this adaptation. While preserving the IP’s iconic essence, we’ve crafted a fresh take on the story, delivering cinematic live-action interactive gameplay that captures the unadulterated spirit of the Northeast underworld and a one-of-a-kind brand of Eastern heroic fervor.

An Iconic IP – Live the Underworld Legend Yourself
The original novel has sold over 40 million copies, and its live-action adaptation is a Douban classic with an 8.8/10 rating! This time, you’re no longer a bystander to the legend—you forge and write your own 20 years of fiery heroism. Step into the Northeast underworld of the 80s and 90s, and make pivotal choices that could either ignite a blazing legacy or lead to total ruin, amid the fire and frost of a transformative era.

Your Choices Shape the Underworld
Play as Zhao Hongbing and navigate the twists and turns of a life of chaos and courage, making choices that split the story into distinct paths at every turn. Stand by your brothers through thick and thin without hesitation, or swallow your pride and endure humiliation just to survive—every decision unlocks a radically different story branch. Will you become a legendary underworld lord? Or will your fiery life burn out too soon, a tragic ballad cut short? Unlock a host of epic, high-stakes endings as you carve your path.

Immersive Era, Meticulous Detail
With top-tier artistic craftsmanship, the game recreates an era where passion and courage ran through every street. From rusted old factory districts to neon-drenched nightclubs, every scene is steeped in the raw, unfiltered energy of 1980s and 90s Northeast China.

Dynamic Relationships, a Vivid Cast of Characters
Every encounter with the classic characters from the live-action series is a collision of fates, forging unbreakable bonds of brotherhood and heroism. The game’s Archive System delves deep into every character’s backstory, breathing life and humanity into them. Uncover hidden character arcs rife with loyalty, betrayal, and unspoken friendship—each one a new layer to the underworld’s rich tapestry.

games.name: Ex-Master, Zombie
games.summary: Rise from the grave and reclaim what was lost. Explore a Metroidvania world, piece yourself back together, and unleash the true power of the Ex-Master. Death is not the end.

games.name: Leaf Blower Co.
games.summary:
Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

Play through the full story of Leaf Blower Co., clear away clutter and bring back a world of peace and tranquillity. And of course, no-one expects you to do all of this for free! Spend your hard-earned cash on new gear, upgrades, and even new styles. It’s important to have the right tool for the job, and if you don’t do it, who else is gonna skin your bin?

games.name: Mercenary Corps
games.summary: Play as Raptor, an experienced mercenary hired to dismantle a network of arms smugglers and terrorists. Infiltrate outposts, eliminate key targets and sabotage enemy facilities.Experience the full campaign solo or in co-op, then enter competitive PvP. Unlock weapons for PvP through a detailed progression system and track your performance with online statistics.- Full campaign playable solo or in co-op.- PvP combat across 9 maps and 2 game modes.- 16 unlockable weapons.- Detailed progression system.- Online player statistics.- Dedicated server support.

games.name: Mr Sticky's Ragdoll Launch
games.summary:
Help Mr. Sticky make his way through challenging physics-based levels filled with ropes, moving platforms, lasers, traps and deadly obstacles. Use the environment and your timing to swing, bounce and launch Mr. Sticky towards the finish.

Every level brings a new challenge, with clever obstacles and physics-based mechanics that will test your timing and precision. Keep an eye on the timer and try to complete each level as quickly as possible without losing control.

Collect all the stars and beat the clock to earn a 3-star rating! Can you conquer every level, set your fastest times and become a true ragdoll master?


Features:
* 32 levels
* Fun physics ragdoll mechanics
* Different traps to avoid
* Collect all 5 stars
* Easy to play hard to master

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary:
Ravenswatch is a top-down roguelike action game that combines intense real-time combat with deep gameplay and high replay value.

After the success of Curse of the Dead Gods, Passtech returns with a new formula and game experience that can be played solo or with up to four players in co-op.

To defeat the Nightmare and reach the final chapter, you will need a strong build, focus and excellent teamwork. Increase your fighting power in battles then face the level boss when you feel ready... or when you no longer have a choice.

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary:
Prepare to adventure into a joyful world with Spirit Crossing, a massively cooperative life sim designed to encourage friendship and make the world feel a little less lonely.

From award-winning cozy games studio Spry Fox, journey through an ever-changing landscape as you spread kindness throughout a vibrant, inviting community.

games.name: Duck Side of the Moon
games.summary: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Moonlight Peaks
games.summary: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids in this heartwarming supernatural life-sim. Eternity awaits!

games.name: POPUCOM
games.summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

games.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.
